title: Emergency Pills Are Not Birth Control ,Learn Why?#contraceptivemethods #birthcontrolmethods
description:
Many people have heard the term contraceptive, but very few truly understand how these methods work and how to choose the right one for their body and future plans.
Contraceptives are medical methods used to prevent pregnancy by interfering with different stages of the reproductive process. Some methods stop ovulation, others prevent sperm from reaching the egg, and some work by preventing fertilization inside the uterus.
Choosing the correct contraceptive method is not just about avoiding pregnancy. It also affects hormonal balance, menstrual cycles, reproductive health, and long-term fertility planning.
One of the most commonly used methods is the condom, which acts as a physical barrier that prevents sperm from reaching the egg. Condoms are unique because they provide protection against both pregnancy and sexually transmitted infections (STIs). For individuals who are unmarried or have multiple partners, condoms remain the safest and most recommended contraceptive method.
Another popular option is hormonal birth control pills. These pills work by preventing ovulation, which means the ovaries do not release an egg during the cycle. While pills can be very effective when taken correctly, they must be used under medical guidance because they influence hormone levels in the body.
Devices like Copper-T or intrauterine devices (IUDs) are placed inside the uterus and create an environment where fertilization cannot occur. These are long-term contraceptive options and are usually recommended for women who want reliable birth control for several years.
A common misunderstanding among many people is the use of emergency contraceptive pills. These pills are designed only for unexpected situations such as contraceptive failure or unprotected intercourse. They should not be used as a regular birth control method.
Frequent use of emergency pills can disturb hormonal balance, lead to delayed or irregular periods, and create unnecessary stress on the body.
It is important to remember that not all contraceptives protect against sexually transmitted infections. Hormonal pills, implants, and intrauterine devices prevent pregnancy but do not provide protection from STDs. This is why barrier methods like condoms remain extremely important for sexual health.
The safest contraceptive method is the one that matches your health condition, lifestyle, and future pregnancy plans. Consulting a qualified gynecologist can help you understand the benefits, risks, and suitability of each method.
If you are unsure about which contraceptive is right for you, professional medical guidance can help you make an informed and safe decision.

Face à une natalité en chute dans de nombreux pays, certaines autorités testent des mesures de plus en plus radicales pour tenter d’inverser la tendance. Derrière ces décisions, un même constat revient partout : la population vieillit, les naissances diminuent, et l’équilibre économique et social commence à être fragilisé.

En Chine, la stratégie prend une tournure controversée avec une évolution fiscale qui a marqué les esprits : les produits contraceptifs ne bénéficient plus des mêmes avantages qu’avant et sont désormais soumis à taxation.

Au Japon, le débat est encore plus sensible. Certaines propositions évoquent une « taxe sur les célibataires », idée qui divise fortement l’opinion publique. L’idée derrière cette proposition est simple sur le papier : les personnes sans enfant ou célibataires doivent contribuer davantage financièrement à la société, avec l’argument qu’elles bénéficient des infrastructures publiques sans participer à la relève démographique.

En Corée du Sud, la réponse est différente. Plutôt que de sanctionner, le pays mise surtout sur les incitations. De nombreuses entreprises sont encouragées à proposer des aides financières, des primes à la naissance ou encore des avantages pour les salariés parents.

In this detailed 3D medical animation, we explore the science behind the copper intrauterine device (IUD) and how it works inside the uterus.

description:

title: Eczema Now — Could Asthma and Allergies Be Next? A Paediatric Dermatologist Explains
description:
If your baby had eczema — this is something your doctor may not have told you. 👇

There is a well-documented clinical pathway called the atopic march.

It describes how one connected allergic tendency moves through the body over time.

It typically looks like this:

🔴 Eczema — often the first sign, sometimes appearing in the first few months of life. The skin barrier is compromised. Allergens enter. The immune system is sensitised.

🟠 Food allergies — the sensitised immune system begins reacting to food proteins. The skin started it. The gut is now involved.

🟡 Allergic rhinitis — persistent runny nose, sneezing, itchy eyes. Frequently mistaken for recurrent colds. Often present year-round, not just seasonally.

🟢 Asthma — the same allergic inflammation, now in the airways. In young children, it often appears as a night cough, frequent chest infections, or tiring easily during play.

This is not four separate problems.

It is one underlying tendency — expressing itself through different organs at different stages.

Not every child follows this path. Some have only one condition. But when I see significant eczema in a young child, I am always thinking about the other three.

Because early skin management — done properly, not just cream-when-it-flares — meaningfully changes the trajectory.

The skin is the starting point. What you do there matters beyond the skin.

皮膚の厚さが違うため

顔は皮膚が薄く、薬が効きやすい

体は皮膚が厚く、薬が効きにくい

つまり、部位に合わせて強さを調整しています。

自己判断で強い薬を顔に使うのはNG

title: Eczema na ba ito?
description:
Dry, makati, at pabalik-balik na rashes? Baka eczema o atopic dermatitis na yan. 

Ang eczema ay chronic skin condition kung saan sensitive ang balat kaya madaling mamula, matuyo, at mangati. Common triggers nito ang sabon, pawis, alikabok, stress, at pagbabago ng panahon.

⚠️ Hindi ito nakakahawa, pero puwedeng pabalik-balik lalo na kapag hindi na-manage nang maayos.

Avoid scratching para hindi lalong ma-irritate ang skin at magtuloy-tuloy ang itch cycle.

title: Roflumilast for Infant Atopic Dermatitis | Patrick Burnett, MD, PhD, at AAD 2026
description:
New pediatric data on roflumilast cream (Zoryve) for atopic dermatitis in infants as young as 3 months was presented at the 2026 American Academy of Dermatology Annual Meeting. In this interview, Christopher Bunick, MD, PhD, speaks with Patrick Burnett, MD, PhD, Chief Medical Officer of Arcutis Biotherapeutics, about what this investigational study means for treating atopic dermatitis in the youngest patients.

In this video, you'll learn why this roflumilast pediatric data is so significant: with very few non-steroidal topical therapies approved for infants with atopic dermatitis, parents and clinicians have long faced limited options beyond topical corticosteroids. The new study, conducted in 101 patients aged 3 to 24 months, showed a strong safety and tolerability profile consistent with older age groups, with 58% of patients achieving EASI 75 at 4 weeks. Perhaps most striking for caregivers: half reported visible itch relief within just 10 minutes of application.

Burnett also previews Arcutis's next steps, including a planned FDA submission in Q2 2026 and investigational work exploring roflumilast for hidradenitis suppurativa and vitiligo.

title: Novo medicamento da Dermatite Atópica: Ebglyss
description:
Novo medicamento para dermatite atópica grave foi incorporado ao rol da ANS 🧴✨

O Ebglyss (lebriquizumabe) agora passa a ser uma opção disponível pelos planos de saúde para pacientes que preenchem alguns critérios.

📌 Quem pode ter acesso?
• Adultos com dermatite atópica grave
• Maiores de 18 anos
• Que já tentaram tratamento com ciclosporina e não tiveram melhora, tiveram efeitos colaterais ou possuem contraindicação.

Até então, a principal opção no rol era o Dupixent (dupilumabe). Agora temos mais uma alternativa.

🧬 Qual a diferença entre eles?
• Dupixent bloqueia duas interleucinas: IL-4 e IL-13
• Lebriquizumabe bloqueia apenas a IL-13

O mecanismo é bastante parecido, mas o lebricizumabe pode ser útil principalmente para pacientes que:
✔️ não responderam tão bem ao Dupixent
✔️ tiveram efeitos adversos, como conjuntivite alérgica

💉 Outra pequena vantagem:
• Lebriquizumabe: aplicação mensal
• Dupixent: geralmente a cada 14 dias

Ou seja, menos injeções ao longo do tratamento.

Ainda que sejam medicamentos semelhantes, ter mais uma opção terapêutica disponível é uma ótima notícia para quem sofre com dermatite atópica grave. 🙌

title: Why sleep quality matters
description:
Why does sleep quality matter during hormonal changes?

Sleep is when the body recovers, restores balance, and regulates important systems like stress responses and temperature control.

When sleep is poor or constantly interrupted, the body may become more sensitive—making symptoms like fatigue, mood changes, and hot flashes feel stronger.

Night sweats and overheating can also create a cycle of broken sleep and increased discomfort.

That’s why sleep quality plays such an important role in overall well-being during perimenopause and menopause.

title: Wenn deine Jeans  #Wechseljahre #Menopause #Frauengesundheit #Hormonbalance #Wechseljahrebeschwerden
description:
Wenn deine Jeans enger sitzt, obwohl du nichts verändert hast (dann ist „reiß dich zusammen“ wirklich kein guter Rat)
1️⃣ Das Gemeine ist: Du machst nichts anders. Du isst nicht plötzlich wie im Urlaub, du liegst nicht nur auf dem Sofa, du bist nicht „disziplinlos“ geworden. Und trotzdem sitzt die Jeans morgens enger, als hätte dein Körper über Nacht beschlossen, dir den Krieg zu erklären. Genau da beginnt der Fehler: Du glaubst, du müsstest härter gegen dich arbeiten.
2️⃣ Stell dir deinen Körper nicht wie eine Maschine vor, sondern wie ein Sicherheitssystem. Wenn Schlaf schlechter wird, Stress länger bleibt, Hormone schwanken oder dein Nervensystem dauernd Alarm hört, speichert der Körper anders. Er hält Wasser. Er verdaut langsamer. Er klammert sich an Energie, als müsste er dich durch einen Winter bringen, den dein Kopf gar nicht sieht.
3️⃣ Gewicht ist nicht nur Fett. Ein bis drei Kilo Unterschied können durch Wasser, Zyklus, Salz, Verdauung, Entzündung oder schlechten Schlaf entstehen. Und trotzdem behandeln viele Frauen jeden engeren Hosenbund wie ein moralisches Versagen. Das ist brutal, weil es Scham auf ein Signal legt, das eigentlich Information sein will.
4️⃣ Die Abkürzung ist nicht weniger essen und noch mehr Druck. Erst stabilisieren, dann verändern. Zwei Tage früher schlafen. Mehr Eiweiß in die erste Mahlzeit. Salz, Alkohol und Snacks nicht dramatisieren, nur beobachten. Spazieren, bevor du dich bestrafst. Krafttraining statt Panik-Cardio. Und vor allem: Miss nicht deinen Wert an einem Stoff, der gerade nur weniger nachgibt als du.
5️⃣ Manchmal ist die enge Jeans kein Beweis, dass du dich verloren hast. Sie ist ein Hinweis, dass dein Körper nicht mehr still alles wegsteckt. Und wenn du aufhörst, ihn wie einen Gegner zu behandeln, passiert etwas Seltsames: Du wirst ruhiger. Klarer. Konsequenter. Nicht aus Hass auf deinen Körper, sondern weil du endlich wieder mit ihm verhandelst.
Wahrscheinlich sehen wir uns nie wieder, also folge @nicolekaps, wenn du mehr davon willst.
Übrigens, wenn du wissen willst, wie du deinen Körper wieder entlastest, ohne dich kaputt zu diäten, dann schreib „LEICHT“ in die Kommentare oder mir als Nachricht. Schau danach direkt in dein Postfach und in den Anfragen, dort müsste eine Nachricht von mir sein mit der Anleitung.

title: Climatério vs. Menopausa: Entenda as Diferenças
description:
Climatério vs. Menopausa: Entenda as Diferenças
Embora os termos "climatério" e "menopausa" sejam frequentemente usados de forma intercambiável, eles se referem a fases distintas na vida da mulher:

Climatério:

Definição: É o período de transição entre a fase reprodutiva e a não reprodutiva da mulher.
Duração: Pode durar vários anos, geralmente começando por volta dos 40 anos e se estendendo até após a menopausa.
Características: Marcado por alterações hormonais graduais, que podem causar sintomas como ondas de calor, alterações de humor, irregularidades menstruais e diminuição da libido.
Fases: Inclui o período pré-menopausa, a menopausa e o pós-menopausa.
Menopausa:

Definição: É o marco que sinaliza o fim da menstruação, definido como a ausência de menstruação por 12 meses consecutivos.
Idade: Geralmente ocorre entre os 45 e 55 anos, mas pode variar.
Causa: É causada pela falência dos ovários, que param de produzir estrogênio e progesterona.
Sintomas: Os sintomas do climatério podem persistir ou se intensificar após a menopausa, incluindo ondas de calor, suores noturnos, secura vaginal e alterações ósseas.

Menopausa significa que o corpo deixou de produzir determinados hormônios. Não significa que você precisa aceitar cansaço, insônia, ondas de calor, perda de libido ou sofrimento como algo “normal”.

Da mesma forma que repomos hormônios da tireoide ou cortisol quando existe deficiência, também é possível cuidar da menopausa com consciência, acompanhamento e equilíbrio hormonal.

Ter o diagnóstico de menopausa não é o fim da sua vitalidade. É o começo de uma nova fase que pode, sim, ser vivida com saúde, disposição e qualidade de vida.

title: If you want to keep pain away during the menopause transition, I sincerely believe what I am telling
description: If you want to keep pain away during the menopause transition, I sincerely believe what I am telling you. 120 minutes of yoga a week I think could change your life. I know you want to snap on me right now by hearing that number. But what if I told you, 20 minutes a day (maybe 10 in the morning and 10 at night) of yoga or joint mobility could help you be in less pain? You are driving your body like you stole it. You are being everything to everyone and you’re on fumes. I wish I could tell you that was a pill to fix this all, but even if we take HRT during menopause, we are still going to have to do some exercise. Joint mobility/yoga/stretching - it is a literal must. Full stop. Heck, I will take 10 minutes a day. If this is all you did, I would give you a gold star still. Second, the resistance training. Here’s why: It loads your muscles, tendons and bones - which helps you stay strong. Your muscle is the organ of longevity - it’s your savings bank. It’s literally going to save your arse when you fall. It will get you off the floor. Weightlifting loads your tendons so they remodel to be stiff - in a good way stiff. Think fresh jeans. We want nice fresh jeans (not clothes line dried jeans, that way too much stiffness). Tendinopathy basically debilitates women during perimenopause. If we can keep your tendons healthy we have a shot of keeping pain at bay. Finally, I ask you to just be mindful and move your body. Cardio? Blood flow to your body, blood flow to your brain. Blood flow is really important for our heart health, bean health and we want to keep our hearts strong. Now I didn’t say anything about jumping or sprinting right now. I’m talking about keeping pain at bay. As a physical therapist, stiffness, tendon issues, being deconditioned are some of the biggest problems I see during perimenopause. Be nice to your joints. Challenge your tendons. Move more. Love you bye 😘 #jointpain #perimenopause #menopause

title: Feeling like yourself again in menopause often takes more than hormone therapy
description:
I’m a huge advocate for HRT. I use it myself and plan to for life.

But here’s what changed everything for me:

HRT alone isn’t always enough.

When I started after my hysterectomy at 42, I expected to feel like myself again… and I didn’t.

title: 알테오젠, 아일리아 시밀러 허가…후발주자 한계 우려
description:
[앵커]
정맥주사제를 피하주사 제형으로 바꾸는 플랫폼 기술로 주목받아온 알테오젠이 이번에는 안과질환 치료제 ‘아일리아’ 바이오시밀러 시장에 도전장을 냈습니다. 하지만 업계의 시선은 기대보다 우려에 가깝습니다. 이미 주요 경쟁사들이 시장을 선점한 데다, 바이오시밀러 간 가격 경쟁까지 치열해지면서 후발주자인 알테오젠의 수익성 확보가 쉽지 않을 것이란 전망이 나옵니다.이슬비 기자입니다.

[기자]
정맥주사를 피하주사로 바꾸는 제형변경 플랫폼 기술로 주목받아온 알테오젠.
최근에는 바이오시밀러 사업으로도 영역을 넓히고 있습니다.

알테오젠은 15일 아일리아 바이오시밀러 '아이젠피주(ALT-L9)'의 국내 품목허가를 획득했다고 공시했습니다.

아일리아는 황반변성 치료제로, 지난해 글로벌 매출 약 13조원을 기록한 블록버스터 의약품입니다.
다만 업계의 시각은 회의적입니다.
이미 국내를 포함한 일부 국가에서는 2024년부터 특허가 만료돼, 바이오시밀러 경쟁이 본격화됐기 때문입니다.

국내 시장만 보더라도 삼성바이오에피스, 셀트리온, 삼천당제약 등이 이미 제품을 출시했습니다.
경쟁 격화로, 가격이 10만원대까지 떨어진 상황.
오리지널 아일리아의 국내 보험 상한가는 49만원대입니다.

알테오젠이 후발주자로 나선만큼 시장에 안착하려면 차별화가 필요합니다.
하지만 오히려 공급 안정성, 가격 탄력성 등에서 불리하다는 분석이 나옵니다.
앞선 기업들은 모두 자체 생산 체계를 갖춘 반면, 알테오젠은 비티젠을 통해 위탁생산할 예정이기 때문입니다.

알테오젠 관계자는 "현금흐름 창출 차원에서 지난 2014년 아일리아 바이오시밀러 개발에 착수했다"며 "당시에는 블루오션이었고, 자사 기술력을 고려했을 때 경쟁력 있다고 판단했다"고 말했습니다.

알테오젠은 우선 지난해 품목허가를 받은 유럽 시장을 중심으로 출시를 추진할 계획입니다.
안과 질환 신약 개발도 병행하고 있습니다.
자회사 알테오젠바이오로직스는 고용량 제형 기술을 적용해 투여 주기를 늘린 황반변성 치료 신약을 연구 중입니다.

한편, 회사는 현재로서는 추가 바이오시밀러 사업 확대 계획은 없다고 밝혔습니다.
바이오시밀러를 핵심 성장축보다는 안정적 현금 확보 수단으로 보고있는 셈입니다.
10년 이상 걸려 나온 아일리아 바이오시밀러가 알테오젠의 새로운 현금 창출원이 될 수 있을지 주목됩니다. 서울경제TV 이슬비입니다./drizzle@sedaily.com

title: 252: How to Use Media Supplements to Tailor Biosimilar Glycan Quality to Your Reference Product i...
description:
Are you still using one-factor-at-a-time experiments for biosimilar development, losing months, missing interactions, and risking costly dead-ends?


In this episode, David Brühlmann, host of the Smart Biotech Scientist Podcast, reveals how traditional "one factor at a time" screening in biosimilar development can take over 12 months, while the parallel group design massively accelerates discovery by grouping up to five factors per experiment and applying a multivariate analysis pipeline.


Topics discussed:

  •  The limitations of traditional and large DoE designs and the advantages of parallel group design (00:08)
  •  Best practices for grouping compounds by biological mechanism with four essential rules (00:53)
  •  The importance of anchor compounds, separating strong modulators, and initial univariate screens for unknown compounds (01:43)
  •  Guidance on managing practical issues, including evaporation, liquid handling, osmolality, and replicating production processes (06:42)
  •  The use of multivariate analysis tools: Principal Component Analysis, Mahalanobis distance, and decision trees for candidate selection (10:14)
  •  Key results and outcomes from applying the parallel group method, including faster and more cost-effective quality modulator identification (12:46)
  •  Three improvements David would recommend today: prequalifying compounds, broader quality analytics, and hybrid modeling integration (13:49)
  •  The shift in mindset from “time problem” to “information problem” in process development (16:50)
  •  Extending the parallel group and multivariate approach to other areas like clone selection and scale-up decisions (17:52)

Smart insight:


Process development is fundamentally about generating actionable information, not just running more experiments. The parallel group, multivariate pipeline lets teams ask better questions, in parallel, with dramatically improved data yield. This mindset and methodology extend well beyond biosimilar media development into clone selection, feed design, and process characterization, wherever complexity would paralyze traditional approaches.


If you want more detail, you can read the full article “Parallel experimental design and multivariate analysis provides efficient screening of cell culture media supplements to improve biosimilar product quality (https://www.researchgate.net/publication/313729525_Parallel_experimental_design_and_multivariate_analysis_provides_efficient_screening_of_cell_culture_media_supplements_to_improve_Biosimilar_product_quality) ” published in Biotechnology and Bioengineering, which outlines the methods and findings behind this approach.


If you’re interested in hybrid modeling, here’s what previous podcast guests have shared on the topic, offering perspectives from fundamentals to real-world applications.

  •  Episodes 05 - 06: Hybrid Modeling: The Key to Smarter Bioprocessing with Michael Sokolov
  •  Episodes 99 - 100: From Raw Data to Actionable Insights: Unlocking the Power of Process Models with Fabian Feidl
  •  Episodes 137 - 138: Skip 90% of Bioreactor Runs: The In Silico Revolution in Bioprocess Development with Yossi Quint
  •  Episodes 173 - 174: Mastering Hybrid Model Digital Twins: From Lab Scale to Commercial Bioprocessing with Krist Gernaey

title: Peptide Sameness Study vs Biosimilar Comparability: What’s the Difference?

Understanding the difference between Peptide Sameness Study vs Biosimilar Comparability is critical for pharmaceutical developers working on complex generics and biologics. In this video, we break down the scientific, regulatory, and analytical distinctions between these two approaches in a simple and practical way.

Peptide-based drugs and biologics follow different development and approval pathways. While peptide sameness studies focus on proving structural and functional equivalence, biosimilar comparability requires a broader evaluation including clinical, analytical, and functional similarity. Knowing when to apply each approach can significantly impact your development strategy, timelines, and regulatory success.

title: Continuous Manufacturing: Why Biosimilar Producers Struggle
description: In the latest episode of the Bioprocessing Unfiltered podcast, Anurag Rathore of the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi, breaks down one of the key barriers holding back the widespread adoption of continuous manufacturing in biopharmaceuticals. Rathore explains that retrofitting an existing batch manufacturing facility for continuous processing is rarely practical — the extent of the changes required makes it financially unviable, and the disruption to ongoing commercial production compounds the challenge. This means companies effectively need to build new facilities from the ground up. For biosimilar producers, who typically operate with tighter budgets than innovator companies, that level of capital investment is a significant hurdle despite the long-term profitability continuous manufacturing can offer. As a result, Rathore notes, it is largely the innovator companies that are leading the way in implementing continuous manufacturing today.

title: Levers For Streamlining And Optimizing The Biosimilar Process
description:
New and more advanced production methods mean biosimilar developers can produce their own versions of commercial drugs with greater efficiency. Levers like cell line engineering and bioreactor controls make it easier to increase productivity. Biologics Consulting Group Principal Consultant Vince Narbut walked through some of the unit operations ripe for optimizing during Bioprocess Online Live: Process Control's Increasing Role In Biosimilar Approval.

When changing key processes, it is important to aim for the mid-range of reference product attribute data to ensure consistent similarity, since developers are now less likely to have clinical efficacy study data to fall back on.
caption: false

title: Comparing Biosimilars To Drifting Reference Product Data
description:
First-time biosimilar developers might be surprised to find significant lot-to-lot quality attribute shifts in their reference product.  

During Bioprocess Online Live: Process Control's Increasing Role In Biosimilar Approval, Cecilia Michel a managing director at Alvotech, said, by default, none of these attributes should be critical quality attributes, but they still matter. To make a defensible biosimilarity assessment, it's important to understand the reference product over a sufficient period of time, which is challenging to do when speed to market is one of the biggest incentives for biosimilars in the first place.
caption: false

title: In Biosimilar Analytical Development, Is A CQA Ever Not Critical?
description:
The word "critical" implies a binary signal. The attribute is either existentially important or it's not.

In biosimilar development, there is a hierarchy of critical quality attributes (CQAs) to monitor during the comparative analytical assessment (CAA). During Bioprocess Online Live: Process Control's Increasing Role In Biosimilar Approval, Biologics Consulting Group Principal Consultant Diana Colleluori said that attributes relating to immunogenicity and function pose a higher risk and must be closely monitored.
caption: false

title: Building A Comprehensive Control Strategy For Biosimilar Analytics
description:
Like many other biologic drugs, building a comprehensive controls strategy for biosimilars starts with defining critical quality attributes (CQAs), said Vince Narbut, a principal consultant at Biologics Consulting Group, during Bioprocess Online Live: Process Control's Increasing Role In Biosimilar Approval.

From there, biosimilar sponsors must map out the critical process parameters (CPPs) used to control upstream and downstream manufacturing, he said. It starts to get tricky when you introduce the originator product's specification range. Narbut said most of the iterative adjustments happen on the upstream side where you can tweak glycan profiles and charge variants.
caption: false

title: How To Avoid A Biosimilar Comparative Efficacy Study, If Possible
description:
Few companies, if any, would ever eagerly volunteer to perform a comparative efficacy study (CES) for their biosimilar candidate. The FDA has been clear all along that compelling a CES remains a tool in its toolbox if the agency believes it's necessary. So what might trigger one, and how can companies avoid it?

During Bioprocess Online Live: Process Control's Increasing Role In Biosimilar Approval, Cecilia Michel, managing director and head of research and development strategy at Alvotech, said the comparative analytical assessment (CAA) is key. The analytical package should include at a minimum orthogonal assays, both physical/chemical, potency, and binding, among others, to truly understand your molecule and its mechanism of action.

Early and ongoing engagement with the FDA is also important.
caption: false

title: In The U.S., Pharmacy-Level Biosimilar Substitution Remains A High Bar
description:
Recent changes in the FDA's biosimilarity assessment guidance do not address the other side of the biosimilar coin, interchangeability. Unique to the U.S., pharmacy-level substitution is allowed only when companies clear an additional regulatory hurdle of receiving an interchangeability designation.

During Bioprocess Online Live: Process Control's Increasing Role In Biosimilar Approval, Diana Colleluori, a principal consultant at Biologics Consulting Group, said that, from her perspective, interchangeability remains a formidable obstacle. However, when it comes to the decline of switching studies, once necessary for interchangeability, FDA now puts greater emphasis on multiple functional assays.
caption: false

title: The Burden Of Proof Has Shifted To Analytics For Biosimilar Approval
description:
The FDA's recent and stunning declaration that comparative analytical assessments (CAA) are generally more sensitive than clinical efficacy studies (CES) shows the great degree in which the agency is leaning on analytics rather than clinical data when considering 351(k) applications for biosimilars.

During Bioprocess Online Live: Process Control's Increasing Role In Biosimilar Approval, Diana Colleluori, a principal consultant at Biologics Consulting Group, explained that it shows FDA is learning along with the rest of us that CES is not the definitive biosimilarity indicator we thought it was.

title: What Is a Biosimilar? Is It the Same as a Biologic? | A Rheumatologist Explains
description:
Your doctor just mentioned a "biosimilar" and you nodded along — but had no idea what they meant.

You're not alone. And you deserve a real explanation.

Here's what every Rheumatoid Arthritis, Psoriatic Arthritis, and Ankylosing Spondylitis patient needs to know:

🧬 WHAT IS A BIOLOGIC?

Biologics are complex medicines made from living cells — designed to target the exact immune pathways driving your inflammation. Think Humira (adalimumab), Enbrel (etanercept), Remicade (infliximab), Cosentyx, Taltz. They transformed autoimmune disease care. They are also expensive — sometimes $100,000+ per year.

💊 WHAT IS A BIOSIMILAR?

A biosimilar is NOT a generic drug. It is a highly similar — but not identical — copy of a reference biologic, approved by the FDA only after rigorous testing to confirm:

✅ Same mechanism of action
✅ Same safety profile
✅ Same clinical efficacy
✅ Same dosage and delivery method

Think of it like this: a generic drug is an exact chemical copy. A biosimilar is the closest possible copy of an incredibly complex biological molecule — proven equivalent through years of clinical trials.

💰 WHY DOES THIS MATTER FOR YOU?
Biosimilars can cost less than the original biologic.
That means:
→ Insurance coverage that was denied may now be approved
→ More patients can access life-changing treatment

For RA, Psoriatic Arthritis, and Ankylosing Spondylitis — the most common biosimilars you may encounter include:
🔹 Adalimumab biosimilars (Humira alternatives): Amjevita, Hadlima, Hyrimoz, 🔹 Infliximab biosimilars (Remicade alternatives): Inflectra, Renflexis

• 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗕𝗶𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲𝘅𝗶𝘁𝘆: Understand why traditional drugs are like simple lemonade (easy to copy exactly), while biologics are like a master chef’s soufflé—grown inside living cells and hundreds of times larger and more complex.
• 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗕𝗣𝗖𝗜 𝗔𝗰𝘁 (𝟮𝟬𝟬𝟵): Learn about the landmark legislation that created the 351(k) abbreviated licensure pathway, allowing for the approval of biosimilar and interchangeable products.
• 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝟭: 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗻: Discover the "microscopic inspection" phase, where the FDA ensures the biosimilar’s 3D molecular shape and active structures line up perfectly with the reference product to meet the "highly similar" standard.
• 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝟮: 𝗖𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗻: Beyond the lab, we explore the real-world human trials required to prove there are no clinically meaningful differences in safety, purity, or potency.
• 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 & 𝗦𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗦𝘁𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗲𝘀: A look at the "gold standard" designation that requires extra evidence to prove patients can alternate between the original and the biosimilar without any loss of efficacy or safety risks.
• 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗰𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝗦𝘂𝗯𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Understanding how state laws dictate whether a pharmacist can automatically swap a brand-name biologic for an interchangeable biosimilar at the counter without a new prescription.

title: FDA Cuts Biosimilar Red Tape — Cheaper Drugs or Just Less Testing? | Karmactive
description:
The FDA recently moved to simplify the approval process for biosimilar drugs — the affordable alternatives to expensive biologic medications treating cancer, autoimmune diseases, and rare conditions. 

Biologic drugs make up just 5% of U.S. prescriptions but account for roughly half of all drug spending in the country. 

The new regulatory framework removes certain clinical study requirements that previously added years and tens of millions of dollars to the development process, with the stated aim of increasing competition and making treatments more accessible for patients.

But is this reform as patient-first as it sounds? Patent barriers remain a documented obstacle for biosimilar developers even after FDA approval, and experts point out that the regulatory pathway is often not the biggest hurdle companies face. 

With only a fraction of biologics nearing patent expiry currently having a biosimilar in development, the real question is whether this reduces burden for patients — or primarily for manufacturers. We break down the facts and the questions that follow.

title: ANALYTICAL RELEASE TESTING of Biosimilars: A Practical Overview
description:
Analytical Methods and Importance

Before a biosimilar drug product can be released for patient use, it must undergo extensive analytical testing to ensure safety, quality, purity, and potency. Because biosimilars are complex protein-based medicines, multiple analytical methods are required to confirm consistency and biological activity.

This video provides an overview of biosimilar drug product release testing and explains the importance of each analytical method used in quality control laboratories.

The following tests are covered in this video:
• Appearance (color and clarity)
• pH measurement
• Osmolality testing
• Size Exclusion Chromatography (SEC)
• Ion Exchange Chromatography (IEX)
• Reverse Phase HPLC (RP-HPLC)
• Endotoxin testing (BET)
• Visible and subvisible particulate testing
• Potency assays
• Cell-based assays
• Sterility testing

Each test is explained with its scientific principle and importance in ensuring biosimilar product quality and patient safety.

title: CH322 Biologics and Biosimilars as Therapeutic Agents
description:

Unlike traditional small molecules, biologics are large, complex therapeutic agents derived from living systems. Their activity depends on higher-order structure, recombinant expression, and highly specific molecular recognition.

Topics covered in this lecture include:

• What defines a biologic drug
• Small molecules vs biologics — key pharmacological differences
• Antibody structure and mechanism of action
• Blocking ligand–receptor signaling pathways
• Case study: Nemolizumab (Nemluvio) and IL-31 in atopic dermatitis
• Pharmacokinetics of monoclonal antibodies (absorption, distribution, elimination)
• Monoclonal vs polyclonal antibodies
• Rabies immune globulin and post-exposure prophylaxis
• Limitations of antibody therapeutics
• Immunogenicity and anti-drug antibodies
• Manufacturing challenges and cost
• Biological escape mechanisms
• Biosimilars vs generics — regulatory and structural considerations

This lecture highlights why medicinal chemistry must now include biologics as a central pillar of modern pharmacotherapy.

Designed for upper-division undergraduate and graduate students in chemistry, biochemistry, and pharmacology.
